highlights.title: Local Reading Memory for Smart Retrieval
highlights.description: Your notes and annotations now build local vector indexes, downloading models directly from ModelScope or Hugging Face. All embeddings run in an isolated process to protect privacy without UI lag.

highlights.title: Explore Connected Evidence from Any Selection
highlights.description: Select text in Web, EPUB, or PDF articles to uncover relevant past reading evidence cards, with one-click navigation directly back to source passages and PDF page coordinates.

highlights.title: Grounded Answers Across Your Reading Library
highlights.description: Ask questions across your reading library to get citation-bound judgments grounded in your actual notes, and turn cited thoughts directly into conversation drafts.

highlights.title: Rock-Solid WeRead Sync and Library State
highlights.description: WeRead sync now runs serially to preserve setting mutations, ebooks use full-file fingerprinting, and the Library maintains pages and active filters across edits and reimports.

highlights.title: Seamless Reading Selection and Chat Context
highlights.description: Saving reading progress no longer clears active selections, chat requests stay strictly bound to the current article with recent context, and interrupted translations recover cleanly.
